GAIL Authorised Medical Attendant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Authorised Medical Attendant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for GAIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Authorised Medical Attendant – Part-Time Visiting Consultant. This is a part-time, temporary, and contract position. Candidates are invited to a walk-in interview for this role.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this GAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Authorised Medical Attendant – Part-Time Visiting Consultant. This is a single opening, so interested and eligible candidates should ensure they meet all the requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for GAIL Authorised Medical Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online. They are required to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue and time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for GAIL Authorised Medical Attendant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Authorised Medical Attendant – Part-Time Visiting Consultant position is scheduled to be held on 24th August 2026. Candidates should plan their travel and preparation accordingly.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this GAIL post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications are an MBBS or MD (Medicine) degree from a recognized University/Institution. Candidates must also possess a valid registration with the Medical Council/National Medical Commission/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Authorised Medical Attendant position?
faq.answer: The consultation charges are Rs. 3,500/- per hour for those with a Specialist PG Degree (MS/MD) and Rs. 2,500/- per hour for MBBS holders. Additionally, local conveyance charges of Rs. 14/- per km will be provided.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue for GAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at GAIL Kailaras Compressor station, Village -Rithonia, Tahsil-Kailaras, District-Morena, Madhya Pradesh - 476224. Candidates must report to this address on the specified date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for GAIL Authorised Medical Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee applicable for this recruitment. Candidates are not required to pay any charges to apply or attend the walk-in interview for the Authorised Medical Attendant position.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry one set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant testimonials/documents, an updated Resume/CV, and two recent colour passport-size photographs. Original documents should also be carried for verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this GAIL vacancy?
faq.answer: The job type for the Authorised Medical Attendant – Part-Time Visiting Consultant position is Part-Time, Temporary, and Contract. This means the role is not a permanent government job and will be for a fixed duration.
